definition.title: AI Conversation Ownership Repair
definition.purpose: Plan eight confirmed conversation defects with existing Asyra owners, explicit lifetimes, formal regressions and preserved canonical behavior. Implementation is not started.

nodes.title: Review ownership design
nodes.objective: Planning only; no implementation acceptance borrowed from prior suites.

criteria.title: Plan, product contract and Flow agree on all eight findings and preserved owners.

nodes.title: Normalize semantic settlement
nodes.objective: Interpret the full invocation once; successful terminal clarification opens answer admission independently of canonical disposition.

criteria.title: F2: real runtime read batches then clarification stay answerable; committed-work disposition remains true even with malformed questions; stale and failed answers rejected.

nodes.title: Materialize request context
nodes.objective: Own one admission transition and immutable public text context; preserve existing per-request image selection, order and canonical requestIntent.

criteria.title: F1/F6: actual serialized multi-question context and failed-answer/detail-choice retry remain correlated; image replacement, native/tool indexes and independent text-only requests preserve existing behavior; no old instruction or permission replay.

nodes.title: Own document-lifetime drafts
nodes.objective: Own keyed drafts for the initApp runtime lifetime; consume a captured revision/generation atomically with authoritative admission before publishing the turn.

criteria.title: F3: real App close/reopen retains drafts; observer re-entry and same-intent submissions consume only the accepted generation; rejection, later typing, empty New, StrictMode and disposal preserve state boundaries.

nodes.title: Complete origin-bound image reads
nodes.objective: Complete reads only into their captured live draft and ordered slot, even while another selected conversation executes.

criteria.title: F4: A read finishing while B runs changes only A; reversed completions, failure, removal and repeated disposal preserve order and reject late callbacks without canvas/history writes.

nodes.title: Preserve answer and storage notice
nodes.objective: Keep authored answer, actual task disposition and storage notice separate; use authoritative receipts, never display text, to establish effects.

criteria.title: F5: advice and drawing replies retained across storage outcomes; partial/failure truth, timestamps, accessibility and 360/1280 layout preserved.

nodes.title: Admit safe explicit retry
nodes.objective: Use trusted real-producer cancellation evidence and the executionStarted-to-transaction contract to admit explicit pre-execution retry.

criteria.title: F7: real runtime cancellation before execution versus after a read or mutation, Feature abort-before-run and racing admission prove safe recovery without duplicate dispatch or replay.

nodes.title: Subscribe to keyed projections
nodes.objective: Reuse existing incremental activity append; publish keyed stable semantic snapshots without reconstructing unchanged settled history.

criteria.title: F8: actual historical reducer and entry construction stay unchanged at 0/10/100 turns during active progress; distinct consumer disclosure states stay isolated; correct active progress, selection, scroll and invalidation remain verified.

nodes.title: Verify integrated preservation
nodes.objective: Run the complete multi-question/image/draft/navigation/storage/retry/cancel/Undo journey and required gates; record exact source and unavailable inputs.

criteria.title: All F1-F8 regressions and integrated 360/1280 journeys pass on one source; retained progress, Undo/Redo, canonical targeting and persistence remain correct.
Inspect complete same-source journey and source-bound regression evidence before closeout

steps.title: Normalize semantic settlement
steps.purpose: Interpret the full invocation once; successful terminal clarification opens answer admission independently of canonical disposition.
inputs: Authoritative Feature/runtime result and correlated action receipts
conditions: Interpret the full invocation once; successful terminal clarification opens answer admission independently of canonical disposition.

Register complete invocation settlement before observable admission or Feature dispatch. Disposal, including re-entry during initial progress, waits until endTurn and all invocation-owned cleanup finish.
bypasses: Failed/cancelled or contradictory receipts cannot open questions. A conversation-protocol diagnostic never rewrites runtime or transaction truth.
allowedContributors: Existing public Asyra contracts and direct App consumers within the matching plan task allowlist.
forbiddenContributors: UI-derived semantic admission, canonical document shadow stores, unrelated framework mutations and inferred legacy compatibility.

steps.title: Materialize request context
steps.purpose: Own one admission transition and immutable public text context; preserve existing per-request image selection, order and canonical requestIntent.
inputs: Admitted user request, current targets and immutable original retry context
Captured composer conversation identity, draft generation and revision; current per-request image set
conditions: Own one admission transition and immutable public text context; preserve existing per-request image selection, order and canonical requestIntent.
Direct wire/provider edits are limited to conversation-context consumption and existing envelope validation; transport, native tools and process lifecycle are preserved.
Historical text is quoted data; only the current request authorizes execution. Runtime credentials/progress are not imported. Reuse existing final-envelope serialization and limits.
Preserve metadata.replyTo.turnId for the existing shared profiler correlation contract; remove only replyTo.intent. conversationContext is the sole authored history, with no compatibility fallback.
bypasses: Explicit new images replace inherited ones; independent text-only requests have none. Retry preserves failed context and question lineage. Existing server ingress validates the final envelope before model/action execution.
allowedContributors: Existing public Asyra contracts and direct App consumers within the matching plan task allowlist.
forbiddenContributors: UI-derived semantic admission, canonical document shadow stores, unrelated framework mutations and inferred legacy compatibility.
implementationBoundary: Only the corresponding T2 plan scope is authorized for this implementation; directory references do not authorize unrelated owners. Internal helpers may be added only for that semantic responsibility.

steps.title: Own document-lifetime drafts

conditions: Own keyed drafts for the initApp runtime lifetime; consume a captured revision/generation atomically with authoritative admission before publishing the turn.
bypasses: Reject stale revision, pending reads and existing active-turn conflicts without input loss; preserve empty-New no-op, navigation lock and view-local disclosures. Dispose retires readers before awaiting runtime shutdown.
allowedContributors: Existing public Asyra contracts and direct App consumers within the matching plan task allowlist.

steps.title: Complete origin-bound image reads
steps.purpose: Complete reads only into their captured live draft and ordered slot, even while another selected conversation executes.
inputs: File selection and captured conversation, draft generation, ordered slot and read identity
conditions: Complete reads only into their captured live draft and ordered slot, even while another selected conversation executes.
Register origin-bound pending slots before notifying draft observers; publish error, pending count and attachments as one snapshot so synchronous submission cannot bypass pending reads.
bypasses: Removal, abort, error or disposal retires the operation. Preserve global execution/navigation lock; pending reads block only their draft admission when no execution is active.

observations.summary: Reviewed all delivered owners, lifetimes, data handoffs and direct consumers. R1-R3 corrected at existing App owners. Release/template/packaging explicitly excluded; no framework implementation changes.

R2 reproduced disposal completing before endTurn from admission/progress notifications (.ai-rereview-settlement-red.log); complete invocation is registered before publication and awaited through cleanup. F2, cancellation, conflicting terminals and real-runtime regressions pass.

Ordered public context, retry image identity, replacement indexes, independent requests, pure profiler correlation and server ingress regressions pass. Actual configured model retains both clarification answers and performs no canvas writes.
App-owned drafts retain input across panel lifetime; generation/revision admission, re-entry, later typing, rejection and document separation pass. Publication-time pending reads cannot be bypassed.

R1 red evidence .ai-rereview-attachments-red.log: observer submitted before pending reads were registered. One publication now owns slots/error/count/images. Actual FileReader and first-notification cancel/dispose tests pass.
Authored replies and authoritative storage notices remain distinct, without changing transaction or persistence truth. Producer and presentation tests pass; responsive screenshots inspected.
Actual Feature/runtime cancellation and negative-shape regressions pass. No replay after observed read/write/transaction; original confirmation and permission owners remain authoritative.

R3 red evidence .ai-rereview-observation-red.log: disposed controls retained an image-bearing active turn. Active controls/reference now retire with projection; whole-snapshot retention removed. Original real 0/10/100 work-count and independent consumer tests still pass.

Frozen source: 2786 App passing executions (2 existing retained-input skips), 414 runtime passes, 69 browser passes (2 unavailable recorded-input skips) including live provider and 16/320/1280 cases. Typecheck/build/lint/naming and Flow tests pass. Evidence .ai-rereview-app.log, .ai-rereview-runtime.log, .ai-rereview-e2e.log and plan re-review section.

Inspected real 360/1280 journey and live-provider screenshots; reviewed original repair and R1-R3 root-owner corrections, preserved semantics and formal regression oracles. Frozen-source App/runtime/browser development gates pass with four explicit retained-input skips across backend/browser suites. No release scope or universal model-quality claim.
